description: This file defines a utility class Path with static methods for handling file system paths, including checking if a path is absolute and joining path segments.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for working with filesystem paths, such as determining if a path is absolute and joining path parts.

methods.name: isAbsolute
methods.description: Checks if a given filesystem path is absolute based on the platform-specific conventions.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Concatenates two path segments into a single path, respecting platform-specific separators.
